rationale: Price has been grinding lower through the last five 1-minute candles (34.28 → 34.20), sitting at only 16.6% of today's range and well below both VWAP ($34.39) and the 9-EMA ($34.26), suggesting continued selling pressure. However, the stock gapped up 2.4% and has already given back most of that gap, making the directional edge ambiguous — a long risks further mean-reversion toward the prior close while a short is entering late into a move that has already traveled ~$1 from the high. With SPY down and VIXY elevated, the risk/reward for either side lacks a clean structural level to anchor a trade with confidence.
